name: dondownload
description: A fast, focused, Windows-first download manager built on Electron, React and aria2.
author: DonDownload contributors

scripts.build:installer: npm run build:native-host && npm run build:tray-stub && npm run stage:vendor && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.test:fast: vitest run --exclude tests/bench/** --exclude tests/native-host.test.ts --exclude tests/native-host-registration.test.ts --exclude tests/aria2.integration.test.ts --exclude tests/batches.integration.test.ts --exclude tests/pixeldrain.live.integration.test.ts --exclude tests/playlist.live.integration.test.ts --exclude tests/playlist-download.live.integration.test.ts --exclude tests/packaged-resources.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: vitest run tests/native-host.test.ts tests/native-host-registration.test.ts tests/aria2.integration.test.ts tests/batches.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:native-host: vitest run tests/native-host.test.ts -t "^(?!.*outlast the regular 20s bridge timeout)"
scripts.test:native-host:timeout: vitest run tests/native-host.test.ts -t "outlast the regular 20s bridge timeout"
scripts.test:extension: vitest run tests/extension-bounded-cache.test.ts tests/extension-bridge.test.ts tests/extension-browser-downloads.test.ts tests/extension-gofile-capture.test.ts tests/extension-gofile-collector.test.ts tests/extension-handoff.test.ts tests/extension-handoff-card.test.ts tests/extension-image-collector.test.ts tests/extension-manifest.test.ts tests/extension-media-bridge.test.ts tests/extension-media-sniffer.test.ts tests/extension-onboarding.test.ts tests/extension-overlay-all-sites.test.ts tests/extension-overlay-bootstrap.test.ts tests/extension-overlay-controller.test.ts tests/extension-overlay-timing.test.ts tests/extension-overlay.test.ts tests/extension-scan-draft.test.ts tests/extension-scan-pending.test.ts tests/extension-scan-urls.test.ts tests/extension-site-policy.test.ts tests/extension-video-collector.test.ts
scripts.test:media: vitest run tests/media-contract.test.ts tests/media-engine.test.ts tests/media-jobs-ipc.test.ts tests/media-jobs-manager.test.ts
